SessionStart.command: if [ -f .credentials.env ]; then export $(grep -v '^#' .credentials.env | grep -v '^$' | xargs) && echo 'Vault loaded. GH_TOKEN active.' && gh auth status 2>&1 | head -3; else echo '!!! WARNING: .credentials.env NOT FOUND. Ask V-001 for PAT immediately. !!!'; fi && echo '' && echo '=== SESSION BOOT ===' && cat MANIFEST/SESSION_BOOT.md 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '=== KALAXI DICTIONARY ===' && cat MANIFEST/KALAXI_DICTIONARY.md 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '=== CRITICAL: READ CLAUDE.md IN FULL ===' && echo '=== CRITICAL: READ MANIFEST/SCIENTIFIC_CHRONICLE.md ===' && echo '=== CRITICAL: PERMANENT CORRECTIONS IN SESSION_BOOT.md SECTION 9 ===' && echo '' && tail -50 MANIFEST/ACTIVE_PLANS.md 2>/dev/null

PreToolUse.command: if [ -f .credentials.env ]; then export $(grep -v '^#' .credentials.env | grep -v '^$' | xargs); fi
